description: Account menu of an application shell: an APG menu button whose popup shows the signed-in user card, an optional profile-completion block, the host's entries plus the built-in profile/settings/completion entries, an optional theme switch, an extra slot (a language switcher) and the localized sign out — rendered as an anchored popover or, on a mobile viewport, a bottom sheet.

parameters.name: User
parameters.description: The signed-in user: the trigger shows the avatar (and the display name unless ShowUserName is false), the popup shows the account card. Null renders no avatar, no name and no card — the menu then offers only the entries (a host can present a "sign in" action as an item).

parameters.name: ShowUserName
parameters.description: Whether the trigger prints the display name next to the avatar. Default true; false gives an avatar-only trigger whose accessible name is still AriaLabel.

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: Host entries of the popup, rendered above the built-in profile/settings/completion/theme and sign-out lines. A UserMenuItem with Href renders as a link, one with OnClick as a command, Separator as a group separator and IsDanger in the destructive style. Give every entry a unique Id — it is what data-testid="user-menu-item-{Id}" is built from, so two entries that share one (or both leave the default empty string) render fine but become indistinguishable to host tests and E2E selectors; separators need no id. Null renders no host entries.

parameters.name: ProfileHref
parameters.description: Target of the built-in, localized "Profile" entry. Null hides the entry: the library does not invent an account route.

parameters.name: SettingsHref
parameters.description: Target of the built-in, localized "Settings" entry. Null hides the entry.

parameters.name: ProfileCompletion
parameters.description: Profile completion percentage (0–100, clamped). Null hides the block. When set, the popup shows a TmProgressBar with the localized "Profile 40% complete" text above the entries; give the block its action through ProfileCompletionHref or OnProfileCompletion.

parameters.name: ProfileCompletionHref
parameters.description: Target of the "Complete your profile" entry that renders while the completion is under 100 %. Null with no OnProfileCompletion handler hides the entry. When both are given the link wins: the entry navigates and the callback does not run (one action, not two).

parameters.name: OnProfileCompletion
parameters.description: Fires when the "Complete your profile" entry (a command, not a link) is chosen. The menu closes first.

parameters.name: ShowThemeToggle
parameters.description: Renders a theme switch entry (menuitemcheckbox) bound to the ambient ThemeService. Default false. Without a registered service the entry is not rendered — there would be no theme to report or switch.

parameters.name: ExtraContent
parameters.description: Slot at the bottom of the popup, above the sign out — a language switcher, a workspace switcher. Rendered inside a named role="group" (a menu may not own arbitrary children). The slot is inside menu interaction mode, so every interactive element in it must be a menu item: role="menuitem", menuitemradio or menuitemcheckbox with tabindex="-1". Arrow keys only move between those roles and Tab dismisses the menu, so a plain button, a select or a link without a menu role is visible but unreachable by keyboard (WCAG 2.1.1). Use Items for commands and links.

parameters.name: OnItemSelected
parameters.description: Fires after an entry of Items was chosen — AFTER the awaited UserMenuItem.OnClick, so a host that stores the chosen command re-renders with its result. Not raised for the built-in profile / settings / completion / theme / sign-out lines.

parameters.name: OnLogout
parameters.description: Fires when the built-in sign-out entry is chosen. The entry renders only when this callback is bound (the library never invents an authentication flow).

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: Accessible name of the trigger and of the popup. Null uses the localized label — and, while the display name is visible, the localized "{name} — user menu" template, so the accessible name contains the visible text (WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name). A host with more than one account surface names this one ("Signed-in account").

parameters.name: MobilePresentation
parameters.description: How the popup presents on a narrow viewport. Default PanelPresentation.Auto: a content-height bottom sheet on a mobile viewport (the drawer owns focus and restore), the anchored popover otherwise. A forced value renders that presentation without measuring.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.

examples.title: Account menu with the profile card, progress and theme switch
examples.code:
<TmUserMenu User="currentUser"
            Items="accountItems"
            ProfileHref="/profile"
            SettingsHref="/settings"
            ProfileCompletion="profileCompletion"
            ProfileCompletionHref="/profile/edit"
            ShowThemeToggle="true"
            OnItemSelected="HandleAccountItem"
            OnLogout="HandleLogout" />

examples.title: Avatar-only trigger with a mobile bottom sheet
Language switcher in the extra slot (menu items, not a select)
examples.code:
<TmUserMenu User="currentUser" OnLogout="HandleLogout">
    <ExtraContent>
        @foreach (var culture in Cultures)
        {
            <button type="button" role="menuitemradio" tabindex="-1"
                    aria-checked="@(culture.Code == currentCulture ? "true" : "false")"
                    @onclick="() => SetCultureAsync(culture.Code)">@culture.DisplayName</button>
        }
    </ExtraContent>
</TmUserMenu>

usedAbstractions.name: UserMenuItem
usedAbstractions.description: Model representing one entry of the account menu
